control.title: Operation Tools

confirm.body: This sends a manual command to the device.

automation.title: Automation rules
automation.fanOnTempAlertDesc: Turn the fan on automatically while a high-temperature alert is open, and off once it closes.
automation.ledOnAlertDesc: Turn the on-site LED indicator on automatically while an alert is open.
automation.overrideNotice: A manual command was sent, so automation is paused for this device for {minutes} more minute(s).

alerts.title: Alerts

upperBreach.title: {device} is above the upper threshold
upperBreach.detail: The reading has stayed above the threshold.

lowerBreach.title: {device} is below the lower threshold
lowerBreach.detail: The reading dropped below the threshold but has since improved.

offline.title: {device} has stopped responding
offline.detail: No data has been received for a while. Please check the power and network connection.

alerts.ackError: Failed to acknowledge the alert. Please try again.
alerts.emptyState: There is nothing to show in this tab.
alerts.footerNote: An alert is only marked Resolved automatically, once the reading returns to a safe range or the device reconnects. You cannot resolve an alert yourself.

summary.title: Today's Summary
summary.quotaNoteUnused: You haven't created one today yet (up to once a day)
summary.quotaNoteUsed: Today's summary has already been created (resets at 3am tomorrow)
summary.cachedNotice: Today's summary has already been created. You can create a new one after 3am tomorrow.
summary.insufficientDataNotice: Not enough data has been collected today yet.
summary.idleDescriptionLine1: Pressing the button turns yesterday's temperature and humidity trends and any notifications into a short written summary.
summary.privacyNotice: Only numeric values are used to create the summary — no names or email addresses are sent.
summary.errorNotice: We couldn't retrieve the summary. Please try again in a moment.
